verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a first-party `block_ads` boolean parameter (default false) that blocks ads on the target page, and the docs explicitly frame it as a way to speed up requests. Related default resource blocking (images/CSS) reinforces the speed-up behavior. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that ad blocking actually speeds up requests, and documentation of which ad networks or elements are blocked.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block ads on the target page to speed up scraping requests

citations.quote: By default, ScrapingBee does not block ads. To avoid scraping them (e.g.,to speed up your request), use `block_ads=true`
Block ads on the page you want to scrape
